comparison: Two official graphs are measured. The Node graph is an esbuild bundle of micromark@4.0.3 and its runtime dependencies as Node resolves them, then Terser or esbuild; it decodes named character references from the character-entities table, as @itslil/micromark does, and its Terser file is the bar. The browser graph is the same package as browsers resolve it: it decodes named references through the DOM and ships no entity table, so it is smaller than any file that carries the table. LilScript rows are the files the compiler wrote: the npm ESM is the compiler's output plus a license banner, and no minifier runs after the compiler. Closed is the same source under lilscript.closed.toml.
